hooks.command: d="$HOME/.cache/claude-skills"; if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then git -C "$d" pull -q --ff-only; else git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/mrdaniil643-prog/claude-skills "$d"; fi && "$d/install.sh" video >/dev/null || true

[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; python3 -c "import faster_whisper, av; assert 15 <= int(av.__version__.split('.')[0]) < 19" 2>/dev/null || pip install -q faster-whisper "av>=15,<19" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
